headline: Herta is in contention to replace Bottas at Cadillac for 2027
body: Cadillac has not settled its 2027 line-up, and reserve driver Colton Herta is among those who could take Valtteri Bottas's seat, The Race understands. Sergio Perez has been the stronger of the pair this year, leading Bottas 13-9 in qualifying.
